_purpose: Japanese locale. Not a market-entry translation — English carries the marketing, this exists so European and American buyers see a Japanese version. Its only job is to be exactly right. Industry terms are used as the Japanese motor-equipment trade uses them: 巻線機, 電機子, 整流子, スロット絶縁紙, ヒュージング, ワニス含浸, ローレット加工, バランシング. Where a term was uncertain it has been left for the client to confirm rather than guessed at.
